# Decorative prop d10070: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10070/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the long reddish-brown shaft with pale bands and the complex bright-silver head: tall central part, symmetrical swept wing-flat metal piece, small lower part, and copper-gold top accent. Render one complete upright tool head on transparent RGBA..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: A harmless static decorative prop for a cosy fantasy game, texture sheet only. Faithfully repaint the binding original MM9 PCX in MM6-MM8 inventory style. Preserve the long reddish-brown shaft with pale bands and the complex bright-silver head: tall central part, symmetrical swept wing-flat metal piece, small lower part, and copper-gold top accent. Render one complete upright tool head on transparent RGBA.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10070/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: image 1 paint_mask_guide.png is the edit target and absolute geometry/layout authority. Image 2 design_reference.png is material/detail reference only. Image 3 icon_x8.png is original colour reference only. Preserve all ten silhouettes exactly, including the small end-on views; do not replace these with upright tools. Output transparent PNG 1536x2048.
CORRECTION: The previous attempt produced substantial stray red mask splatters and changed head outlines. Start from the original grey guide again. Exactly preserve its alpha silhouettes, position and scale. No stray pixels anywhere. Lower-half mask views must have perfectly solid clean interiors and crisp boundaries matching the guide, no speckles or holes. Do not add a pointed cap beyond the guide geometry. Reddish-brown wooden shaft segments must be yellow in the material masks, including the butt segment; silver bands and copper collars red. Upper-half paint must be unlit base colour, without strong directional highlights or dark ambient occlusion. Retain original 3:4 canvas.
